messages:
Maya Chen: Quick check-in: were updating Hosted, Dedicated, and Private landing copy. Goal: sharper benchmark lines + two CTA variants and clear routing for inbound leads. Freeze Wed EOD.
Ethan Brooks: Ill take Dedicated SLA phrasing and the pricing CTA. Also want a short technical callout about GPU pools.
Sam - copy: Ill draft three micro-headlines each page (product-first, trust-first, and action-first). Will keep Hosted more developer-friendly.
Riley (growth): Routing rules proposal: Hosted -> signups -> self-serve; Dedicated -> demo request -> AE; Private -> security review -> AE + security eng. Also, immediate AE if "compliance", "enterprise", "on-prem" keywords present.
Maya Chen: Good. Also try to make the Hosted benchmark non-jargon heavy for marketing: something concise for the hero that still signals performance.
Sam - copy: Hosted hero candidate A: "Start with a high-performance hosted API fast, reliable, pay-as-you-go." B: "Production latency without infra ops get started in minutes."
Ethan Brooks: Dedicated hero candidate: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and cost" + subline: "SLA-backed uptime and configurable autoscale."
Sam - copy: Private headline candidates: "Private deployment with VPC & on-prem options" and "Enterprise controls, customer-managed networking."
Riley (growth): CTAs (two versions to A/B):
- Hosted: "Create free account" / "See performance benchmarks"
- Dedicated: "Request capacity" / "Get pricing"
- Private: "Talk to sales" / "Request security brief"
Maya Chen: Nice. Add UTM scheme: utm_source=landing&utm_campaign=tri_mode_test&utm_content=cta_variant1. Riley will wire to SFDC.
Sam - copy: Benchmark microcopy suggestions: Hosted: "Sub-200ms 99th pct on typical production traffic"; Dedicated: "Predictable throughput with reserved capacity (contact for graph)"; Private: "Isolated deployment with enterprise SLAs & KMS support."
Ethan Brooks: Can infra supply a concise token/sec stat for Dedicated? Id like one line: "Up to 300k tokens/s per cluster" (placeholder).
Riley (growth): For lead routing YAML Ill include keyword match and company_size heuristics, then map to queue: AE, security, or self-serve. Also adding a UTM->lead_type mapping.
design-bot: Reminder: page hero layout will be A/B tested with control at 50/50. Provide final copy by Wed 17:00 PT.
Maya Chen: Next steps: Sam posts full text drafts here by EOD today. Ethan will confirm Dedicated numbers by tomorrow noon. Riley posts routing YAML and UTMs. I'll combine and hand to design.
Sam - copy: On it  uploading first pass in 90 minutes.
Maya Chen: Thanks team! :rocket:
